grf.observed_reality: PR #352 Needle candidate used raw target.startswith(target_prefix) in both compile-time adapter selection and execute-time adapter revalidation.
grf.generated_reality: For hierarchical ResourceRef targets, a scoped prefix could lexically capture sibling resources whose string begins with the same bytes.
grf.counter_reality: target_prefix could intentionally denote a broad opaque namespace, so a repair that blindly requires slash children could break deliberate scheme-wide registrations.
grf.discriminating_test: Sibling-prefix smuggling against file:///srv/frank/data, with exact/child and broad file:// controls.
grf.collapse: Lexical sibling overmatch CONFIRMED. Exact/child semantics retained; deliberately broad prefix roots ending '/' or ':' retained. URI/path dot-segment and percent-encoding normalization remains unproven and separate.

unusual_experiment.name: SIBLING_PREFIX_SMUGGLING
unusual_experiment.counter_control_result: All four lexical siblings rejected while exact scope and slash-child remained admitted.

evidence.primary_external_reference: RFC 3986 path segments are slash-separated; used only to motivate lexical segment-boundary discrimination, not as proof of product containment semantics.

counterevidence_and_open_falsifiers: ClayCode declares NeedleIntent.target as ResourceRef and requires target matches target_prefix, but the current candidate contract does not define canonical URI/path normalization semantics.
Dot-segment and percent-encoded traversal forms remain outside this repair and must not be represented as fixed.
The branch remains diverged from current main; current-main composition evidence is successful for head 117b3799 but must remain distinct from branch-isolated evidence.
PR #352 remains open, draft, and unmerged; no canonical promotion is claimed.
next_falsifier: Define or locate canonical ResourceRef normalization/containment semantics at the ClayCode/effect-authority boundary, then test raw, dot-segment, percent-encoded, query/fragment, scheme-wide and opaque-namespace cases without widening Needle authority.
